caption_en: Navigation during GNSS position interruptions. (a,b) Horizontal and heading errors for the first registered 20-s interruption; gray shading marks the interrupted interval, and the inset enlarges its first 8 s. The dual- and single-position IEKFs omit their position updates, while the baseline-retaining IEKF continues relative-baseline updates. LegSA-GINS retains its available heading and robot-motion aids. (c,d) Whole-run RMSE for every registered 10-s and 20-s interruption, with nine placements per duration; thin lines connect the same placement across methods. The baseline-retaining IEKF preserves heading but does not automatically improve positioning. Logarithmic scales retain all finite outcomes.
caption_zh: GNSS位置中断时的导航结果。（a,b）首个登记20秒中断的位置和航向误差，灰带表示中断区间，小窗放大中断后的前8秒；双位置和单位置IEKF停止位置更新，保留基线的IEKF继续进行相对基线更新，LegSA-GINS保留可用航向及机身运动辅助。（c,d）全部10秒和20秒中断的整段RMSE，每个时长九个布置；细线连接同一布置的四种方法。保留基线的IEKF维持了航向，但没有自动改善位置结果。对数坐标保留全部有限结果。
meaning_zh: 上排显示位置中断中误差如何增长，下排说明这一现象在全部18个登记条件中的分布。
